_說明: 市場解讀清單。每兩星期：① 把 PDF 放入 content/updates/（檔名用英文或數字，例如 2026-11-02.pdf）；② 喺下面 posts 最頂加一項。status：published（公開）或 draft（草稿）。highlights 係 3–5 句重點，會直接寫入網頁俾搜尋引擎同讀者睇（建議填寫，唔填都得）。部署時會自動生成 /updates/<id>/ 頁面。 英文版：每期加 title_en、summary_en、highlights_en（同 highlights 一樣多句）、period_en；PDF 用中文都得。

posts.title: 雙週市場速遞：科技巨頭業績分化、晶片股一日崩跌、聯儲局按兵不動
posts.title_en: Fortnightly market notes: Big Tech results split, chip stocks plunge in a day, the Fed holds
posts.summary: 微軟 Azure 增長 48%，Alphabet 卻單日跌 12.6%；Intel 指引疲弱令晶片股週五大跌，納指全週 -2.0%；聯儲局維持利率但有兩票主張加息，資金轉向防守板塊。
posts.summary_en: Microsoft's Azure grew 48% while Alphabet fell 12.6% in a day; Intel's weak outlook sank chip stocks on Friday and the Nasdaq lost 2.0% for the week; the Fed held rates with two votes for a hike, and money moved into defensive sectors.
highlights: 大科技業績有人歡喜有人愁：微軟 Azure 增長 48%，股價升約 4%；Alphabet 自由現金流轉負，單日跌 12.6%
Intel 第四季指引疲弱，單日暴跌約 29%，費城半導體指數當日 -7.2%，拖累納指全週 -2.0%
聯儲局維持利率 3.75%–4.00%，但有兩票主張加息；市場估 12 月加息機會約 75–85%
資金轉向醫療、原材料、公用事業等防守板塊；恒指全週 +0.9%，恒生科技指數 -3.0%
荷莫茲海峽有油輪遭水雷襲擊，布蘭特原油維持每桶約 113 美元；黃金、比特幣下跌
highlights_en: Big Tech results were mixed: Microsoft's Azure grew 48% and its shares rose about 4%; Alphabet's free cash flow turned negative and it fell 12.6% in a day
Intel plunged about 29% in a day on a weak fourth-quarter outlook; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 7.2% that day, pulling the Nasdaq down 2.0% for the week
The Fed held rates at 3.75%–4.00%, but two members voted for a hike; markets put the chance of a December hike at about 75–85%
Money rotated into defensive sectors such as healthcare, materials and utilities; the Hang Seng Index rose 0.9% for the week while the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 3.0%
A tanker was hit by a mine in the Strait of Hormuz and Brent crude held at about US$113 a barrel; gold and bitcoin fell

posts.title: 雙週市場速遞：AI 晶片股急跌、油價重上 110 美元、各地央行未敢放鬆
posts.title_en: Fortnightly market notes: AI chip stocks slide, oil back at US$110, central banks hold off on easing
posts.summary: 納指錄 6 月以來最差一週，資金由科技股流向傳統板塊；布蘭特期油重上 110 美元；美國 9 月 CPI 升至 3.7%，三大央行月底議息。
posts.summary_en: The Nasdaq had its worst week since June as money rotated from tech into traditional sectors; Brent crude climbed back to US$110; US September CPI rose to 3.7%, with three major central banks meeting at the end of the month.
highlights: 納斯達克指數一週跌 4.5%，係 6 月以嚟最差一週；晶片股連跌 8 日
布蘭特期油重上每桶 110 美元，中東同俄烏局勢令供應憂慮升溫
美國 9 月 CPI 按年升 3.7%，高過預期；聯儲局 9 月已加息至 3.75%–4.00%
恒指兩週大致喺 24,000 點附近上落，恒生科技指數較弱
10 月 28 至 30 日美國、歐洲、日本三大央行相繼議息，值得留意
highlights_en: The Nasdaq fell 4.5% in a week, its worst week since June; chip stocks fell for 8 days in a row
Brent crude futures climbed back to US$110 a barrel as the Middle East and Russia–Ukraine situations heightened supply worries
US September CPI rose 3.7% year on year, above expectations; the Fed raised rates to 3.75%–4.00% in September
The Hang Seng Index hovered around 24,000 over the two weeks, with the Hang Seng Tech Index weaker
The US, European and Japanese central banks meet in turn from 28 to 30 October, worth watching
